title: Pakistan High-Speed Diesel Benchmark Falls Below Government Limit
excerpt: The high-speed diesel pricing benchmark in Pakistan has dropped further, with the diesel crack spread decreasing to $35.56 per barrel.
body_html:
The high-speed diesel pricing benchmark in Pakistan has experienced a further decline, moving below the government's established limit once more.

According to recent reports, the diesel crack spread has dropped to $35.56 per barrel. This downward movement marks another instance of the benchmark falling beneath the threshold set by the authorities.

Further details regarding the potential impact on domestic fuel prices or specific government policy measures were not provided in the update.
